approved_scope.title: Add stable document identities transactional patches and diagnostics for release preparation
approved_scope.description: Add stable document identities transactional patches and diagnostics for release preparation
acceptance_criteria: Optional stable plane IDs survive text and binary round trips without changing existing parsing or z links; immutable Sendable typed patches apply atomically with bounded operation counts and exact revision preconditions; duplicate IDs invalid coordinates missing targets stale revisions and cancellation return structured diagnostics with no partial document; release docs publish Swift-first capabilities migration examples and a compatibility matrix; the full pinned Trust lane and strict SpecSync pass with actual evidence; feature PRs remain open for Leif to merge and no release is published.
